evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the recognizable framing: 'it looks like we have availability... This will take 10 to 15 minutes, and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on.' Instead moved straight to confirming contact info and asking for concerns.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'Besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answer on this call today?' — but this came after probing had already started (unit number and address were confirmed first). Actually, reviewing more carefully: the rep confirmed contact info and email first, then asked the agenda question, then began probing. So this was asked relatively early, but not before the initial discovery routing.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (third floor, fourth floor at destination), number of rooms (1 bed / 2 bed), walking distance (20-50 feet to elevator), special considerations (queen mattress, small safe, two floor-length mirrors, one 55-65 inch TV, one smaller TV), additional stops (second address), parking notes (busy park, loading dock elevator reservability).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Bri: 'Is that something that you were interested in having us pack your smaller items into boxes.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Bri: 'A typical box count for a move this size would be between fifteen and twenty five boxes. Do you feel like you would fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Bri: 'A typical move this size usually takes two movers, one truck between two and a half to three to four hours and then just with the elevator access, I would think that your move would take between three to four hours.' Then: '$576 would be three hours and then $768 would be four, and then if we added the kitchen... We're looking at $1,056 plus supplies.' This is anchored to typical home size with personalization for elevator access and packing service.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Bri: 'Everything is included in the hourly rate looks like for Sunday October 25th the hourly rate is $192 for two movers and 126 foot box truck... There's no deposit to get on our schedule so there's no risk and secure in your spot. There's actually no fees or charges to change or cancel that as well... The time starts as soon as we get on site and open the contract... two and a half hour minimum... prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Also disclosed the $189 packing materials cost structure.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Bri: 'Does that sound fair.' followed by a pause. Sophie responds: 'Yeah. Yeah, I think so.' Rep held silence and waited for customer response.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Bri: 'If we can't make it in a time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill. The way the clock works is the time starts as soon as we get on site and open the contract you then have us for as long as you need us for any move.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Bri: 'We do have that no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.' Coverage amount, 'free' / 'included' language, and no-deductible framing all present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. Instead moved directly into the estimate discussion after covering the two promises.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Bri: 'Would you like us to help you with your move on Sunday October 25th?' Plainly asked, no softened out offered.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Bri: 'There's no deposit to get on our schedule so there's no risk and secure in your spot.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Bri confirmed: date (Sunday October 25th), arrival time (8:39 AM), addresses (pickup 3833 Dune Lobby Street Unit 342, drop-off 4310 Dunlay Street Unit 415), crew size (two movers, one truck), phone number already confirmed at top of call. Rep also noted parking concerns for the crew and will send confirmation email. Crew notes about parking and elevator access were captured in the conversation.

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details across both addresses (parking constraints, elevator access, fragile items, special considerations) and used those specifics to personalize her estimate credibly rather than quoting a generic range.
coaching_note: Section 1 is missing its load-bearing quid pro quo framing entirely ('it looks like we have availability... 10 to 15 minutes... quote you can depend on') — jump straight to the framing before moving to confirmation and discovery, and pause for a yes before continuing.
